themes_detail.label: Street Lights Failing Across UWS
themes_detail.summary: Street light outages spiked to 23 complaints THIS WEEK, up 124% from the 10.2 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks (z-score: 4.53), suggesting a potential grid-wide or weather-related failure affecting neighborhood safety and visibility.
evidence: 23 street light complaints THIS WEEK vs. 10.2 weekly average (z-score: 4.53)
124% spike represents statistically significant deviation from 8-week baseline
Outages create public safety concerns in high-density residential area
reporting_angles: Interview Con Edison about cause of outage cluster and repair timeline
Document resident safety concerns and walking patterns after dark in affected blocks

themes_detail.label: Park Noise Crisis Explodes
themes_detail.summary: Noise complaints from parks surged to 5 complaints last week, a 900% spike from the 0.5 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 6.36, highest severity), suggesting a specific emerging disturbance pattern requiring immediate investigation.
evidence: 5 park noise complaints last week vs. 0.5 weekly average over 8 weeks (900% increase, z-score: 6.36)
Highest z-score among all spikes, indicating most statistically anomalous trend
Represents sudden shift in neighborhood quality-of-life complaints
reporting_angles: Interview Parks Department and NYPD about which parks are affected and what noise sources are involved
Survey residents in proximity to major parks (Central Park, Riverside Park) about disruption to daily life

themes_detail.label: Street Conditions Rapidly Deteriorating
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints jumped to 165 last week, up 301% from the 41.1 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 4.77), signaling accelerated pavement failure or pothole formation across the district in a single week.
evidence: 165 street condition complaints last week vs. 41.1 weekly average (301% increase, z-score: 4.77)
Street conditions are top 90-day complaint category (875 total), now accelerating sharply
Weather events or delayed maintenance likely culprits requiring verification
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Transportation to identify which streets are most affected and repair schedules
Document photos of worst affected intersections and gather resident complaints about safety hazards for cyclists and pedestrians

themes_detail.label: Rodent Infestation Spike on Private Property
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary animal complaints on private property surged to 4 last week, up 433% from the 0.8 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 4.91), suggesting emerging rodent or pest control problems in residential buildings.
evidence: 4 unsanitary animal complaints last week vs. 0.8 weekly average (433% spike, z-score: 4.91)
Part of broader sanitation concern (580 total unsanitary condition complaints over 90 days)
Indicates possible systemic pest management failure across multiple properties
reporting_angles: Interview NYC Department of Health about rodent complaint patterns and whether pest pressure is rising city-wide
Speak with building managers and tenants about access to pest control services and cost barriers

themes_detail.label: Code Enforcement Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Special Projects Inspection Team (SPIT) complaints jumped to 9 two weeks ago, up 350% from the 2.0 weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 4.04), indicating residents are escalating complaints about code violations that routine inspections are missing.
evidence: 9 SPIT complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 2.0 weekly average (350% increase, z-score: 4.04)
Corresponds with long-standing CB budget request to 'expand code enforcement' from Department of Buildings
Suggests enforcement capacity may be insufficient for district demand
reporting_angles: Request detailed complaint data to identify which building types or violations are driving SPIT escalations
Interview Department of Buildings about SPIT deployment and whether Upper West Side is under-served by routine inspections
